TANGLE_KELP_DESCRIPTION.english:
{SHORTLINE}
{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive
{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, on contact
{AQUATIC}Must be planted in water
{SHORTLINE}
{FLAVOR}"I'm totally invisible," Tangle Kelp thinks to himself. "I'll hide here just below the surface and 
nobody will see me." His friends tell him they can see him perfectly well, but he'll never change.

JALAPENO_DESCRIPTION.english:
{SHORTLINE}
{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} massive
{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} all zombies in a lane
{KEYWORD}Usage:{STAT} single use, instant
{SHORTLINE}
{FLAVOR}"NNNNNGGGGGG!!!!!!!!" Jalapeno says. He's not going to explode, not this time. But soon. Oh, so soon. 
It's close. He knows it, he can feel it, his whole life's been leading up to this moment.

WINTER_MELON_DESCRIPTION.english:
{SHORTLINE}
{KEYWORD}Damage:{STAT} very heavy
{KEYWORD}Range:{STAT} lobbed
{KEYWORD}Firing Speed:{STAT} 1/2x
{KEYWORD}Special:{STAT} melons damage and freeze nearby enemies on impact
{KEYWORD}Must be planted on melon-pults
{SHORTLINE}
{FLAVOR}Winter Melon tries to calm his nerves. He hears the zombies approach. Will he make it? Will anyone make it?
WINTER_MELON_DESCRIPTION.chinese:
{SHORTLINE}
{KEYWORD}伤害：{STAT}非常高
{KEYWORD}范围：{STAT}投掷
{KEYWORD}发射速度：{STAT}1/2倍速
特点：{STAT}击中后造成范围伤害并减速
{KEYWORD}必须被种植在西瓜投手上
{SHORTLINE}
{FLAVOR}冰西瓜试着让自己紧绷的神经冷静下来。他听到僵尸的接近。他能做到么？有人能做到么？

CRAZY_DAVE_303.english: Crazy Dave's Twiddydinkies is open for business! {MOUTH_SMALL_SMILE}
CRAZY_DAVE_303.chinese: 疯子戴夫的闪闪亮杂货店正式营业了！

CRAZY_DAVE_304.english: Have a look! See if you can't find something you like! {MOUTH_SMALL_SMILE}
CRAZY_DAVE_304.chinese: 来瞧一瞧！你是否找到了一些你喜欢的东西！

CRAZY_DAVE_2000.english: {NO_SOUND}{NO_CLICK}Plant these on your repeaters to turn them into gatling peas! Gatling peas shoot four peas at a time!
CRAZY_DAVE_2000.chinese: {NO_CLICK}把这些种在你的双重射手上，把它变成机枪射手！机枪射手一次能射出4颗豌豆！

CRAZY_DAVE_2502.english: BREAK IT LIKE YOU MEAN IT, HARVEY! {SCREAM}
CRAZY_DAVE_2502.chinese: 就按照你的意愿去打破它吧，哈维！

CRAZY_DAVE_2601.english: {SHOW_FERTILIZER}I'll give you some fertilizer for stopping by!
CRAZY_DAVE_2601.chinese: 我会顺便给你一些化肥的！
